gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads tall and generous, its s curves opening wide at both ends with no thick-thin shift. Cherry Swash goes above it with a horseshoe c and a blunt, showy build, a display voice resting on a sturdy sans.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-merriweather-sans: Cherry Swash arrives with a horseshoe-shaped c and heavy diagonals. Merriweather Sans follows with sturdy, tall lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, so the moderate heading sits above a larger-looking body.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-public-sans: A horseshoe c gives Cherry Swash away at once. Public Sans carries hefty lowercase with broad open counters, and next to the heading it feels trustworthy and plain-spoken where the display face stays showy.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-ranade: Cherry Swash has a blunt, round-tip marker feel from end to end. Ranade loosens things with widely spaced type and only a slight shift in weight, and that mild, organic stroke is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-supreme: Cherry Swash opens its c like a horseshoe and sets heavy diagonals to make a commanding, distinctive headline voice. Supreme, a plain sans, simply keeps its letters held open and crisp.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-general-sans: Distinctive is the word for Cherry Swash, with its horseshoe c. General Sans has an x-height that fills the line, so give it a little extra size and its smooth, unobstructed bends stay easy to follow.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-orbit: Showy meets restrained here. Cherry Swash does its best work with a horseshoe c and heavy diagonals, while Orbit, a plain sans, floats its characters apart on rope-like stems that stay quiet.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-science-gothic: Approachable is how Science Gothic feels, though Cherry Swash speaks first with its horseshoe c. Stroke ends sit far apart in the body, and that spaced-out, one-letter-at-a-time pace is the pair's strongest quality against the heavier heading.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-syncopate: Syncopate reads like it was drawn with a technical pen, its spacing like rungs on a rope ladder. And Cherry Swash, with its horseshoe c and heavy diagonals, is what gives this pair its bold, commanding edge.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-manrope: Approachable up front, Manrope has bright open mouths on every curve. Cherry Swash does commanding best with a horseshoe c and heavy diagonals, while the body does quiet clarity best, one line width throughout.
